title: mogorium sambac
intro: Mogorium sambac, commonly known as the fragrant jasmine or jasmine sambac, is an evergreen flowering plant native to tropical Asia. The health benefits of Mogorium sambac include its potential to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation due to its sedative properties, and it has also been traditionally used to alleviate symptoms of insomnia and restlessness. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit anxiolytic and anticonvulsant effects, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety disorders. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and volatile oils, including benzyl benzoate and linalool, are responsible for the medicinal properties of Mogorium sambac.
